settings.importDescription: Import or create exports of your vault

appearance.trayDescription: Quickly copy codes while Tauthy is running

security.passwordDescription: Set a password for unlocking your vault
security.autoLockDescription: Lock app after 1 minute of inactivity

import.exportEncryptedDescription: Protect a portable Tauthy backup with a password

sync.description: Sync accounts through encrypted files in your cloud folder. Tauthy keeps a separate file for each device so simultaneous changes do not collide. Local changes work offline.
sync.createDescription: Create a new encrypted file in your cloud folder
sync.joinDescription: Connect this device to an existing Tauthy sync file
sync.createPasswordDescription: You will need this password to connect another device or recover your accounts. Tauthy cannot recover it for you.
sync.joinPasswordDescription: Enter the sync recovery password used when this file was created.
sync.mergeConflictedCopyDescription: Recover changes from a file your cloud service marked as conflicted. The selected file is kept.
sync.disconnectDescription: Stop syncing without deleting local accounts or the sync file
sync.disconnectWarning: This device will stop syncing. Your local accounts and the encrypted sync file will not be deleted. Continue?

modals.password: Choose a password for your encrypted vault
modals.passwordInsecure: Password should be at least 8 characters
modals.importPasswordDescription: Enter the password used to encrypt this {{format}} backup.
modals.exportPasswordDescription: Choose a password you will remember. Tauthy cannot recover it for you.
modals.deleteWarning: This will delete your vault and can not be undone. Are you sure?
modals.exportWarning: This export is not encrypted and contains your authentication secrets. Store it securely. Continue?

toasts.import2FasEncrypted: Password-protected 2FAS backups are not supported. Export a backup without a password from 2FAS and try again.
toasts.importEncryptedAuthenticationFailed: The password is incorrect, or the backup has been damaged or modified.
toasts.importEncryptedCorrupt: The encrypted backup is corrupted or has been modified.
toasts.importEncryptedUnsupported: This backup version or encryption configuration is not supported.
toasts.importEncryptedNoPasswordKey: This backup has no password key and can only be unlocked by its original app.
toasts.importTauthyNewerVersion: This backup was created by a newer version of Tauthy. Update Tauthy and try again.
toasts.importTauthyDuplicateIds: This backup contains duplicate account IDs and cannot be imported safely.
toasts.importTauthyIdConflict: An account in this backup conflicts with a different local account using the same ID.
toasts.importUnsupportedOtp: The backup contains OTP formats Tauthy does not support yet. Only 6-digit SHA-1 TOTP entries with a 30-second period can be imported.
toasts.importFailed: Import failed. Check that you selected the correct backup format.
toasts.syncConflictMerged: Conflicted copy merged. Keep it until all devices show the recovered accounts.
toasts.syncAuthenticationFailed: The sync recovery password is incorrect, or the file was modified.
toasts.syncConflict: The local and synced vaults contain an account conflict that cannot be merged safely.
toasts.syncCorrupt: The sync data is damaged or invalid.
toasts.syncFileExists: That file already exists. Join it or choose a different filename.
toasts.syncPickerFailed: The file picker could not be opened.
toasts.syncUnavailable: The sync file is currently unavailable. Check that your cloud folder is accessible.
toasts.syncUnsupported: This sync file version or encryption configuration is not supported.
toasts.syncFailed: Sync failed. Your local vault was not lost.
